# evroc_bucket_service_account_secret (Data Source)

Retrieves S3-compatible credentials for a bucket service account. These credentials can be used to access evroc object storage from any S3-compatible client.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the bucket service account.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.
